verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion is a fair question for a self-hostable team chat and workspace product, but the evidence pack documents no retention policies, message or history deletion, or purge controls. Self-hosting ('that place is yours', the Helm chart with your own Postgres/S3) and the branch-protection '--no-delete' flag are adjacent features, not retention or deletion controls, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
